body: Slice 1 of STORY-1728 is implemented as draft PR #2727. All checks are green locally: full lib suite 9090/0, check-ci-fast 30/30, and the golden help snapshot is byte-identical. To land it I need: (1) your ack of amendments A1–A3; (2) a ruling on help_after anchors (they keep help order stable and make REGISTRY order meaningless, which settles by-name vs by-module); (3) dropping acceptance 5 (Windows CI is impossible under ADR-72); (4) a C2 quiet window. Details are in the latest STORY-1728 comment and the PR body.
subject: STORY-1728 slice 1 ready for review: draft PR #2727 (needs ack + quiet window)
